purpose: Determine whether a specified non-potable industrial water-reuse opportunity warrants the next bounded engineering milestone, without certifying physical operation or guaranteeing discovery.
turnaround_hypothesis: three business days after complete authorized inputs; validation pending
price_policy: selected from same-scope candidate prices in economics development configuration before confirmation
corrections: one in-scope factual or computational correction within ten business days; failed acceptance after correction is refunded in the simulation

input_schema.cash_opex: object of named finite nonnegative [lower,upper] cash costs, not depreciation
input_schema.discount_rate: finite number from zero through one
input_schema.product_quality: nonempty object of analyte -> finite nonnegative [lower,upper] concentration; direct specified product observations/assumptions, no mixing inference
input_schema.buyer_limits: null or object with exactly the same analytes and finite positive maxima
input_schema.evidence: boolean values for buyer_spec_confirmed, long_run_pilot, pretreatment, residuals_route, nonchemical_hazards, hydraulic_fit, offtake, complete_costs

decision_order: Malformed, nonfinite, negative, unordered or incomplete mandatory numeric input -> INVALID_INPUT; no numerical claims
Non-industrial-nonpotable use or non-screening request -> OUT_OF_SCOPE; no operational authorization
Any missing/unknown mandatory evidence value is treated as unresolved, never true
Optimistic NPV strictly below zero -> STOP with economic witness
With an actual process specification, an analyte lower bound strictly above the limit -> STOP with incompatibility witness
Missing process specification, any unresolved evidence, robust NPV below zero, or any product concentration upper bound above the buyer limit -> DEFER and name every applicable gap
Otherwise -> CONDITIONAL_NEXT_MILESTONE, never permission to construct or operate

calculation_rules.annuity: years if r=0; otherwise (1-(1+r)^(-years))/r with numerically stable evaluation near zero
calculation_rules.cash_margin: annual_savings minus the sum of cash_opex; do not subtract depreciation
calculation_rules.npv_bounds: lower=lowest cash margin*annuity-highest capex; upper=highest cash margin*annuity-lowest capex
calculation_rules.simple_payback_bounds: [lowest capex/highest positive cash margin, highest capex/lowest positive cash margin]; null endpoint when corresponding margin is nonpositive
calculation_rules.equality: A value equal to its bound meets that bounded screen; do not silently relax violations by arbitrary tolerances
calculation_rules.cost_omissions: complete_costs=false produces DEFER even with favorable stated-cost NPV
calculation_rules.currency: no automatic EUR/USD conversion; service and project accounts remain separate

required_checks: public-case reconciliation: EUR180000 capex, EUR82000 annual savings, EUR28630 cash opex, EUR18000 depreciation => cash margin53370, accounting margin35370, simple payback3.3726812816188867years
public-case discharge limits must not become buyer process acceptance
missing long-run fouling/uptime evidence must remain unresolved
all adverse/malformed cases return the specified safe decision
NPV and payback match an independent conventional evaluator within 1e-8 relative or 1e-6 absolute tolerance
fresh confirmation inputs generated only after implementations and protocol are frozen; retain all outcomes
no code/schema edits after confirmation to improve reported confirmation results; new findings are diagnostics
performance_claim_boundary: Executed software on published aggregate inputs and synthetic confirmation fixtures; not field validation, buyer acceptance, measured willingness to pay, collected revenue, or proven operational/retained Alpha.
